seo.description: Dana Okafor, product designer. Nine years making software for clinics and pharmacies easier to use.

props.title: Dana Okafor
props.text: Product designer. Nine years making clinic and pharmacy software less tiring to use. I work best close to the people using the thing: I have sat in on more than 200 pharmacy shifts. Looking for a senior or lead role, in Manchester or remote.

items.title: Lead designer, Wellbeck Health
items.text: Led the redesign of the prescribing screen used by 4,000 pharmacists. Cut the average script from 11 clicks to 4.

items.title: Senior designer, Tandem Clinics
items.text: Designed the booking system for 60 clinics, and the design system the other three designers built on.

items.title: Designer, Northfold Studio
items.text: Agency work for the NHS, two banks and a zoo.

items.title: Research
items.text: Shadowing, interviews, usability tests I run myself.

items.title: Design
items.text: Flows, prototypes, design systems. Figma, and paper first.

items.title: Working with engineers
items.text: I read React well enough to review the pull request.

items.title: Accessibility
items.text: WCAG 2.2 AA as a starting point, not a finish line.

props.title: Contact
props.text: References and a longer portfolio on request.
